The corroboration this rule used to rest on — contiguous, non-overlapping groups agreeing with the beamtime notes' own `Sample N` sections — is still true and is no longer what the reading depends on. THE RULE ID IS DELIBERATELY STILL `.v1`: the reading is byte-identical, because this recognizer always read the token to the same value and only the caveat beside it has been retired. A version bump would say a filename now reads differently, which it does not. STILL NOT A GRAMMAR: the meaning is confirmed, the POSITIONS are not, which is why recognition remains by shape and alias and this ordinal is the only ordering rule here.. The original text is kept beside the value.

official_record_validation.reason: A bundle is not an official record. Official validation runs on an exported record (`isaac validate <record> --official`).

validation.statement: Checked against bundle-v1 (schema plus bounds, state and reference consistency) when written. `isaac bundle check <dir>` re-checks it.

readiness.next_step: Review the conflicts and the values that need review with the scientist who ran the beamtime, and look at the unread files. No value here is confirmed, and none is eligible for an official record until a scientist confirms it.

authorities.source_evidence: What a file literally says, at a locator: sources[], every evidence[] entry's literal_value, extended_context[], data_quality_notes[], contributors[]. Never rewritten; normalisation is recorded beside the literal, not over it.
authorities.extraction_interpretation: What the deterministic readers, stored rules and (later) AI interpretations made of the evidence: candidates[] values, conflicts[] recommendations, ai_interpretations[]. Suggestions only; an AI interpretation can raise a value to needs_review and never higher.
authorities.scientist_confirmation: scientist_decisions[] only. The sole source of scientist_confirmed and rejected. Recorded by the local user; this build cannot verify identity, and decided_by.basis says so.
authorities.deterministic_schema_validation: The official ISAAC schema and validators (`isaac validate --official`, `isaac export`). They judge official RECORDS, not this bundle; validation.official_record_validation is therefore not_applicable here. This bundle is checked only against its own bundle-v1 contract.
